stem:
The diagram shows three parallel light rays heading toward three mirrors Vivaan sets up: a plane mirror, a concave mirror, and a convex mirror.

Which claim correctly predicts the rays after reflection?

options.text: After the plane mirror the rays stay parallel; the concave mirror can bring them together; the convex mirror spreads them apart.
After every mirror the rays must meet at one point, including the plane mirror.
After the plane mirror the rays must behave exactly like rays through a converging lens.
Only the silver paint colour of each mirror decides the ray paths, not the mirror shape.

teacher.key_rationale: Parallel rays stay parallel at a plane mirror, can converge after a concave mirror, and diverge after a convex mirror. Forcing every mirror to focus, treating the plane mirror like a converging lens, or judging from paint colour miss that hinge.
teacher.figure_note: Rewrote source converging-lens ray diagram into three mirrors with parallel incident rays.
